title: PuroClean
description: puroclean.com purocleanfranchise.com PuroClean is North America's largest privately owned property damage restoration franchise, known as "The Paramedics of Property Damage®", with 500+ franchise locations across the U.S., Canada, and Puerto Rico, headquartered in Tamarac, Florida. It provides 24/7 emergency services — water damage mitigation, fire and smoke restoration, mold remediation, biohazard cleanup, and reconstruction — responding within two hours, and is a preferred provider for 3 of the top 5 U.S. insurance carriers. The brand was launched in 2001 under the legal entity PuroSystems, LLC; in 2015 it was acquired by Mark W. Davis (former co-founder/CEO of Belfor North America) and Frank Torre, who grew the network from 222 to 500+ locations. The franchisor's audited revenue is $31.8 million (FY2025), while system-wide franchise sales exceed $400 million, with an average franchise unit generating ~$942K per year.
